headline: Qualcomm launches Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chips
summary: Qualcomm announced two new flagship phone chips, the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 and an Extreme version, with Motorola's Signature 27 among the first phones to use the Extreme model. One report says the new top chip can run a 30B-parameter model locally. Outlets differ on how notable the Extreme model's upgrades are.
